items.name: storage-vercel-blob
items.title: Storage: Vercel Blob
items.description: Implements lib/storage/* with Vercel Blob (direct client uploads, auth-checked token route). Requires env BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (vercel blob store / Vercel dashboard). Replaces the base stubs: install with --overwrite.
items.docs: Set BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN (create a Blob store in the Vercel dashboard and run `vercel env pull .env.local`). Upload with uploadFile() from lib/storage/client.ts.

items.name: storage-r2
items.title: Storage: Cloudflare R2
items.description: Implements lib/storage/* with Cloudflare R2 (S3 API, presigned direct uploads). Requires env R2_ACCOUNT_ID, R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID, R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, R2_BUCKET, optional R2_PUBLIC_URL. Bucket needs a CORS rule allowing PUT from the app origin. Replaces the base stubs: install with --overwrite.
items.docs: Add a CORS rule to the R2 bucket: [{"AllowedOrigins":["http://localhost:3000","https://YOUR-APP.vercel.app"],"AllowedMethods":["PUT","GET"],"AllowedHeaders":["*"],"MaxAgeSeconds":3600}]. R2_PUBLIC_URL is optional (custom domain / r2.dev); without it, getFileUrl returns 1h presigned GET URLs.

items.name: clerk-webhook-sync
items.title: Clerk webhook user sync
items.description: Adds a users table and /api/webhooks/clerk (user.created/updated/deleted upsert/delete). Requires env CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. After install run `pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate`.
items.docs: 1) pnpm db:generate && pnpm db:migrate. 2) In the Clerk dashboard add an endpoint https://YOUR-DOMAIN/api/webhooks/clerk subscribed to user.created, user.updated, user.deleted and copy the signing secret to CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. 3) Local dev: `clerk webhooks listen --token "$(clerk webhooks token)" --forward-to http://localhost:3000/api/webhooks/clerk` or a tunnel. The route is already public in proxy.ts.
